svg.title: One lease number. Three different records.
svg.desc: Mobile-first documentary diagram by Final Vestige Studios. State Lease 195 appears in a 1965 federal appellate opinion involving Stone Island royalties, a 1970 Louisiana Supreme Court title case, and a 2023 Bohemia Tract 193 state agency mineral nomination. The two opinions disagree about whether Lease 195 dates to February 20 or February 28, 1928. The original lease has not been checked. The records do not establish that the litigated parcels and Bohemia Tract 193 are identical.
svg.metadata: Author: Final Vestige Studios. Date: 2026-11-18. © 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Original editorial schematic, not a historical photo, survey, lease, or reconstruction. Rights: studio-authored original, no third-party media incorporated.

g.text: Not a title or parcel-boundary ruling

Original lease and survey are needed.
